You are looking to found a startup and have strong experience in building businesses and managing processes but you don’t have the right co-founder to start with? Do you have a deep industry knowledge capable of identifying future trends? Are you a proactive person and problem solver? If so, this is the opportunity for you!

Startup Wise Guys (SWG), the hottest B2B accelerator in Europe, with a +70% survival rate among founded companies, invites you to participate in The Founders Club. Engage with other co-founders, define a powerful idea, and initiate your B2B Startup.

Tasks

As a co-founder, you will be responsible for all aspects of the company along with your partners:

  • Develop a concept and obtain a proof of concept by defining the product/service, defining strategies and plans, and of course implementing those.
  • Build and lead your team and implement a strong culture.
  • Define and lead investment rounds.

Requirements

  • Solid experience of at least 7 years, preferably working with fast-growing and scale-up companies.
  • Relevant leadership experience in one of these areas: Strategy, leading sales (CEO-CMO candidates), Product development, strategy, and/or operation team (CTO -COO candidates), Finance (CFO candidates).
  • Resolution to launch a B2B scalable startup (preferably SaaS, XR, Sustainability, Fintech, or Cyber).
  • MSc or MBA in business administration or relevant field.

Benefits

Join our 12-week fully online program and gain:

  • Week per-week guidance on how to build a successful start-up.
  • Access to +550 mentors with specific know-how of the sector you want to attack.
  • Access to SWG graduate network: +450 startups in +40 countries

This is an internal role at Weekday. Not a role by a client.

  • Role type: Full time
  • Location: Remote
  • Working days: Monday–Saturday
  • Working with: The founders and the AE team

Weekday is an AI-native recruiting platform. We are backed by Y Combinator and Venture Highway (now General Catalyst). We have built the largest white-collar talent database in India and have built tools to run outbound recruiting campaigns to them.

About the role

You will own outbound sales to Indian startups. Not support it. Own it. You find the companies, you get in the door, you run the demo, you close, and you hand over a customer who knows exactly what they bought.

We have an AE team of three today. It works, and it closes. Now we need to scale it, and you will be a critical part of that. That means two things: you carry your own number from week one, and you help figure out what the team looks like at ten. What's repeatable, what isn't, what to write down, what to throw out. The people we hire after you will run on what you help build.

We sell to founders and heads of talent at startups that are hiring. They are busy, sceptical, and have been burned by recruiting agencies before. Your job is to show them, in one call, why a talent database of this size plus outbound campaigns gets them hires faster than anything else they've tried.

If you want a clean job description with neat boundaries, this isn't for you. If you want to be one of the people who scaled the sales engine at a profitable, venture-backed company, read on.

What you'll actually do

On any given day you might be:

  • Building your own target list of Indian startups that are hiring, and figuring out who the real decision-maker is
  • Running cold outbound across email, LinkedIn, and phone, and iterating on what actually gets a reply
  • Running demos that are built around the prospect's open roles, not a generic walkthrough of the product
  • Closing subscription deals and handling pricing, procurement, and the "let me think about it" that never comes back on its own
  • Handing closed accounts over to the delivery team cleanly, so the first month goes well and the renewal takes care of itself
  • Keeping the pipeline honest in the CRM, and reporting the numbers to the founders every week, including the ugly ones
  • Sitting with the other AEs to work out what's working across the team, and turning it into process the next hires can run on

You'll be measured on closed revenue and pipeline built. Not on activity, not on slides.

What we're looking for

  • You've sold B2B before, ideally to startups, ideally something a founder had to say yes to. You know what a real pipeline looks like.
  • You're comfortable with cold outbound. Not tolerant of it. Comfortable. You'd rather send fifty good emails than wait for a lead.
  • You can run a demo that feels like a conversation and ends with a next step.
  • You close. You ask for the deal, you handle the objection, and you don't confuse a friendly call with a sale.
  • You take ownership. When a number is yours, it moves, and nobody has to follow up with you.
  • You've seen a sales team grow, or you want to be the person who makes it grow. You think about the system, not just your own quota.
  • You understand the Indian startup ecosystem, who's hiring, who's raising, and who's about to need ten engineers in a hurry.
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and a Monday–Saturday pace.

What you get

  • An early seat on a sales team that's about to scale, at a profitable, venture-backed company
  • Direct access to the founders and a say in pricing, positioning, and what we build next
  • A product with real pull: the largest white-collar talent database in India and outbound tooling that companies actually get hires from
  • A clear path to leading a team as the function grows, if you earn it
  • A front-row seat to how a startup gets built and run, and the track record to show for it when you build your own

Location: Remote (United States)

Work Model: Remote

Industry: HR technology

Compensation: $100K-$125K base, $200K-$250K OTE

About the Company

Our partner is a Series A HR technology company backed by top-tier venture investors. Their platform lets companies hire and pay people anywhere: an Employer of Record product for international hiring, alongside US payroll and compliance and a full HR suite. The business grew roughly 20x from 2024 to 2025 and is on pace to multiply again this year. The team is about 20 people across two US hubs and remote, with a results-first culture that cares about outcomes rather than hours logged in a particular place.

The Opportunity

This is a founding Account Executive seat on a sales team that is just getting built: today it is one Account Executive and one SDR. You will sell the core Employer of Record product to SMB and mid-market companies hiring internationally, with the same kind of motion and quota structure used by the leading global employment platforms, plus early-stage equity. A dedicated post-sale team takes over after close, so your focus stays on winning new business.

Their team is hiring its first VP of Sales now and plans to add more Account Executives within a couple of months, so early hires have a real chance to help shape the team as it grows. Expect a fast-moving, high-expectation environment.

Responsibilities

  • Own the sales cycle from first meeting through close, working alongside SDR support
  • Build and manage your own pipeline of SMB and mid-market companies hiring internationally
  • Sell the core global employment product and position bundled payroll and HR products where they fit
  • Hand closed customers cleanly to the post-sale team
  • Help shape the sales playbook, messaging and process as an early member of the team
  • Share what you learn from the market with the founding team

Requirements

  • 1+ years of closing experience as a senior SMB or mid-market Account Executive
  • Experience selling Employer of Record, global employment or global payroll is strongly preferred; adjacent HR or fintech sales experience is also relevant
  • A consistent track record of meeting or exceeding quota
  • Experience selling at a startup or high-growth company
  • Comfort working autonomously in a remote, results-driven environment
  • Interest in growing with the company as the sales team scales

You’ve built strategies, managed complex projects, advised companies or led teams. Now you may be wondering what it would look like to build something of your own.

Startup Wise Guys is looking for experienced professionals who want to explore entrepreneurship, meet complementary co-founders and start building a scalable B2B company through The Founders Club.

This opportunity is particularly relevant for consultants, former consultants, operators, product leaders and senior professionals looking for a more entrepreneurial and creative next chapter.

You don’t need to leave your current job. Founders Club is a 12-week, part-time and fully online venture-building experience, designed to let you test entrepreneurship before making a major career transition.

Tasks

During the programme, you will:

  • Identify and validate relevant B2B problems and opportunities.
  • Meet potential co-founders and build a complementary founding team.
  • Run customer discovery and test market demand.
  • Define your business model and go-to-market strategy.
  • Build and test an MVP or proof of concept.
  • Develop the foundations of a scalable, investable startup.
  • Work with founders, mentors and investors from the Startup Wise Guys ecosystem.

You can join with an existing idea or startup, but you don’t need to have one yet.

Requirements

We are particularly interested in professionals with 7+ years of experience in:

  • Management consulting or strategy
  • Business development and sales
  • Product and technology
  • Operations
  • Finance
  • Marketing and growth
  • Industry-specific roles

You should be interested in entrepreneurship, comfortable solving ambiguous problems, and able to bring meaningful expertise to a potential founding team.

An MBA or MSc can be valuable, but practical experience and execution matter more.

Benefits

Over 12 weeks, you will enter the broader Startup Wise Guys ecosystem, including:

  • 480+ startups invested in
  • 600+ mentors and experts
  • Founders operating across 40+ countries
  • 20+ portfolio exits
  • Around 70% portfolio survival rate
  • Direct access to potential co-founders, experienced entrepreneurs and early-stage investors
  • A structured way to explore entrepreneurship without making an immediate all-or-nothing career move

The strongest teams emerging from Founders Club may later become relevant for Startup Wise Guys’ acceleration and investment activities, subject to a separate assessment.

Selected candidates will receive further information about the programme structure, participation requirements and next steps before making any commitment.

About Vector Legal

Vector Legal is a modern solution for startup legal: combining a full-service law firm with a purpose-built AI (VectorAI) platform. We're backed by some of the best investors in Silicon Valley, including Y Combinator, Base10, Transpose Platform, and others, to reinvent the way that legal solutions are delivered for Startups.

We support companies across their lifecycle, including complex formations, fundraising and priced rounds, commercial contracting, hiring and team changes, mergers and acquisitions, and dissolutions. VectorAI powers agentic data rooms, proprietary draft/review/negotiate tools, e-signatures, cap table management, legal health checks and more.

Our goal is to make high-quality legal work faster, more scalable, and more cost-efficient.

About the Role

We’re hiring a Full Stack Engineer to build and scale end-to-end web applications across our platform. This role sits at the intersection of product, infrastructure, and applied AI, working closely with a small, fast-moving team to ship features that directly impact customers.

You’ll own development across the stack: from frontend interfaces to backend APIs, data models, and external integrations. The environment is highly iterative, with a strong bias toward shipping, learning, and refining quickly. If you enjoy operating with autonomy, working on ambiguous problems, and building systems from first principles, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain full-stack features across frontend (React) and backend (TypeScript APIs)
  • Design and implement scalable data models using NoSQL databases
  • Integrate third-party services (e.g., APIs, auth, payments, document systems)
  • Work with AI coding tools and agent-driven workflows to accelerate development
  • Own features end-to-end, from initial concept through deployment and iteration
  • Collaborate closely with product and design to translate requirements into shipped functionality
  • Improve system performance, reliability, and developer experience over time
  • Contribute to architectural decisions as the platform evolves

Qualifications

  • 2–5 years of experience building production-grade web applications (excluding internships)
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript and modern React frameworks
  • Experience designing and working with APIs and distributed systems
  • Familiarity with NoSQL databases and flexible data modeling patterns
  • Comfort using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., code generation, copilots, agents)
  • Experience in a startup or high-velocity environment preferred
  • Ability to operate independently and take ownership of ambiguous problems
  • Strong product intuition and focus on delivering user value

Destro AI is building the intelligence layer for robotics — the system that coordinates robots, humans, and workflows across complex real-world operations. Destro is backed by investors who have previously invested in and built companies like Brex, Figma, Notion, and Instacart.

Destro's MothershipOS is a shared brain across all robots, unlocking complex factory and warehouse workflows. Unlike traditional systems that rely on local intelligence on each robot, Destro brings global intelligence across the entire operation. Destro recently closed its Seed round at one of the highest valuations for a robotics company at this stage, and is already deploying in production with large enterprise operators

About The Role

We're hiring a Founding Recruiter to build and run Destro's talent engine. This is one of the first ten hires at the company, and you will own hiring end-to-end as we scale from a small founding team to 20 to 30 new hires a year, most of them engineers. Who You Are

About Roboto

Roboto is the analytics engine for Physical AI. Robotics teams produce massive amounts of multimodal data from cameras, lidars, IMUs, motors, and batteries, and most have no good way to make sense of it. We ingest every robotics log format, automate the analysis, and surface the failures and patterns that actually matter, so teams can ship reliable robots at any scale.

We started from a different premise than the rest of the field. Robotics teams aren't bottlenecked by visualization. They're bottlenecked by analysis. So before we built another dashboard, we built the engine underneath: one SDK that reads every robotics log format natively, configurable agents that triage failures automatically, and search that works across a fleet, not one log at a time. That's our moat.

Role Overview

This Founding Account Executive role is a mixture of technical understanding, vision, partnership, and value-driven strategy.

You'll be a key driver of opportunities through the entire sales cycle, from prospecting and deal execution to long-term account growth. You'll work with engineers, founders, and customers shipping drones, surgical robots, and more into production.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in early-stage environments, loves building from zero, and is excited to help define how Roboto's analytics engine gets deployed across industries.

What You'll Do

  • Own the full sales cycle. From cold outbound to signed contract. You find your way to the right buyers, earn their trust, and close.

  • Generate your own pipeline. You're a hunter who builds from zero. Outbound, events, partner channels, open source community, whatever works.

  • Become a product expert. Run technical discovery, demo credibly to engineering and product teams, and translate platform capability into a clear business case.

  • Serve as a trusted advisor. Deeply understand your customers' priorities and help them deploy automated analytics in ways that actually move their business forward.

Who You Are

  • A genuine hunter. You create your own pipeline, move deals forward with urgency, and don't wait to be told what to do next.

  • Technically fluent. You sell to engineers and can hold your own in a technical conversation. You understand APIs, SDKs, and developer workflows, and you can pick up new technical concepts quickly. Familiarity with robotics, ROS, PX4, or sensor data is a plus, but the curiosity to learn matters more than the prior exposure.

  • Customer-obsessed. You care about outcomes, not just signatures, and you build relationships that last beyond the close.

  • Energized by hard problems. Bespoke deals, new verticals, and undefined playbooks don't intimidate you. They motivate you.

  • A sharp communicator. You write clearly, present with confidence, and adapt from a platform engineer to a C-suite exec.

Why Join Roboto

  • Roboto sits at the center of the Physical AI stack. You're not just selling software, you're working alongside engineers building the infrastructure that lets robots run reliably at scale.

  • Robotics is at an inflection point. The companies that win the next decade will define the category, and you'll be one of the first commercial hires helping shape that.

  • Direct exposure to how frontier robotics gets built and deployed at scale, across drones, surgical devices, and autonomous vehicles.

  • Competitive compensation with meaningful equity and real performance upside. We want to build a small, high-performing team that has real ownership.
